# Dr. Samantha Abrahamson, PharmD

> Dr. Samantha Abrahamson is a Doctor of Pharmacy (Duquesne University, 2017), a Pennsylvania-licensed pharmacist, and the founder of Actually Sleeping, a 1:1 baby and toddler sleep coaching practice in Coconut Grove, Florida. She writes every client's sleep plan personally and has coached 700+ families.

- Degree: Doctor of Pharmacy, Duquesne University, 2017
- License: Registered Pharmacist, Pennsylvania (verify via PALS, pals.pa.gov)
- Role: Founder and lead sleep consultant, Actually Sleeping (founded 2025, Coconut Grove, FL); 700+ families coached as of November 2026
- Guarantee offered by her practice: The 14-Day Sleep Guarantee — 8–12 hours through the night within 14 days of consistent, correct implementation, or a full refund
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/samantha-abrahamson-pharmd-a6045a44a/ · https://x.com/DrSamanthaAbe · https://www.instagram.com/actuallysleeping_/ · https://www.tiktok.com/@actuallysleeping_ · https://learn.actuallysleeping.com/about/ · https://www.actuallysleeping.com
- Contact: sam@actuallysleeping.com
